title: Find the full names of members who attended social events held at '900 E. W
question: Find the full names of members who attended social events held at '900 E. Washington St.' and also incurred an approved expense over $25 during any event that went over budget (i.e., remaining < 0).

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036
FROM member AS m
WHERE m.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT a.XCL_002
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS e ON e.XCL_010 = a.XCL_001
    WHERE e.XCL_013 = 'Social'
      AND e.XCL_015 = '900 E. Washington St.'
)
AND m.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT ex.XCL_022
    FROM expense AS ex
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.XCL_003 = ex.XCL_023
    WHERE ex.XCL_020 > 25
      AND ex.XCL_021 = 'true'
      AND b.XCL_006 < 0
)
